name: Revenue
definition: IFRS revenue, the total revenue line. REITs: rental income plus other property operating income (hotel revenue, service charges, finance-lease income on leased property); finance income, fair-value and disposal gains, dividends and other income are excluded.

name: Gross profit
definition: Revenue less cost of revenue, where the income statement presents gross profit; blank for nature-of-expense layouts.

name: Profit before zakat and income tax
definition: As reported (continuing operations).

name: Finance costs
definition: Finance costs as shown on the face of the income statement (including interest on lease liabilities). Where a company shows only a net finance line, it is used as reported (noted on the company sheet).

name: Finance income
definition: Finance income as shown on the face of the income statement.

name: Share of results of associates and joint ventures
definition: Equity-accounted share of profit or loss of associates and joint ventures.

name: Operating income (calculated)
definition: One definition for every company (C): profit before zakat and tax + finance costs − finance income − share of associates and joint ventures. Other gains and losses printed below the company's own operating profit (FX, fair-value results, disposal gains) are therefore inside it; material ones are listed in the One_offs register.

name: Depreciation and amortisation (cash flow)
definition: All depreciation and amortisation add-backs in the cash-flow reconciliation, including right-of-use assets and, where present, biological assets.

name: Impairment of non-financial assets (cash flow)
definition: Impairments and reversals of property, plant and equipment, intangibles, goodwill, investment property and equity-accounted investments, from the cash-flow reconciliation. Expected credit losses on receivables and other provisions are excluded.

name: Fair-value gains on investment property
definition: Unrealised fair-value gains (losses negative) on investment property, for companies using the fair-value model (Cenomi Centers). Inside operating income, excluded from EBITDA.

name: EBITDA (calculated)
definition: Operating income (calculated) + depreciation and amortisation + impairments of non-financial assets − fair-value gains on investment property (C). Before rent under IFRS 16.

name: EBITDA excl. identified one-offs
definition: EBITDA (calculated) less one-off gains, plus one-off losses, listed in the One_offs register with their source page (C).

name: Zakat and income tax
definition: Zakat plus income tax charged in the income statement (continuing operations).

name: Net profit for the period
definition: Profit for the period after zakat and tax, including non-controlling interests and discontinued operations.

name: Net profit attributable to shareholders
definition: Profit attributable to owners of the parent (funds: unitholders). Kept as reported; never adjusted for one-offs unless the filing gives both the tax/zakat effect and the minority share.

name: Net profit attributable to non-controlling interests
definition: As reported.

name: Operating cash flow
definition: Net cash from operating activities as reported. Companies differ on whether interest paid is inside operating or financing cash flow (noted on each company sheet).

name: Capital expenditure
definition: Cash purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes right-of-use additions, key money, biological assets, investment property, investments and business acquisitions.

name: Investment-property spend
definition: Cash spent on investment property (acquisitions, development and additions), from investing cash flow. Shown for owners of let property; non-cash additions and disposal proceeds are not netted.

name: Capex incl. investment property
definition: Capex plus investment-property spend (C). Used for the capex intensity of the mall operators.

name: Free cash flow
definition: Operating cash flow less capex less investment-property spend (C). Lease payments are not deducted (they are financing cash flows under IFRS 16).

name: Total assets
definition: Period-end.

name: Total equity
definition: Period-end, including non-controlling interests.

name: Equity attributable to shareholders
definition: Period-end equity attributable to owners of the parent (funds: net assets attributable to unitholders, book value).

name: Cash and cash equivalents
definition: Cash and cash equivalents on the statement of financial position at period end.

name: Short-term bank deposits
definition: Term, time and murabaha deposits with banks shown in current assets outside cash and cash equivalents. Excludes restricted or pledged deposits, money-market funds and other investments.

name: Borrowings
definition: Interest-bearing borrowings at period end, current plus non-current: term loans, murabaha and tawarruq facilities, sukuk, overdrafts and shareholder loans. Excludes lease liabilities.

name: Lease liabilities
definition: IFRS 16 lease liabilities, current plus non-current.

name: Net debt
definition: Operating companies: borrowings + lease liabilities − cash and cash equivalents − short-term bank deposits (C). REITs: borrowings − cash − short-term deposits. Negative = net cash.

name: Funds from operations
definition: Net income + depreciation and impairment of real estate (investment property, hotel and other property assets, right-of-use assets) − gains on property disposals (C).

name: Gain on disposal of properties
definition: Gain (loss) on sale of investment property included in net income; deducted in FFO.

name: Distributions declared
definition: Cash distributions to unitholders declared for the period.

name: Net asset value at fair value
definition: Net assets with investment property at fair value, as the fund reports it (the statements carry property at cost less depreciation and impairment).

name: Gross margin
definition: Gross profit ÷ revenue.

name: EBITDA margin
definition: EBITDA (calculated) ÷ revenue.

name: EBITDA margin excl. identified one-offs
definition: EBITDA excl. identified one-offs ÷ revenue.

name: Operating margin
definition: Operating income (calculated) ÷ revenue. Can exceed the EBITDA margin where fair-value gains on investment property are inside operating income (Cenomi Centers).

name: Net margin
definition: Net profit attributable ÷ revenue.

name: Return on equity (funds: return on net assets)
definition: Net profit attributable ÷ average of opening and closing attributable equity; 9M and short years annualised (× 12 ÷ months). n.m. on zero or negative average equity; such companies are left out of group ROE.

name: Capex intensity
definition: Capex ÷ revenue (malls: capex incl. investment-property spend ÷ revenue).

name: Net debt / EBITDA
definition: Net debt at period end ÷ EBITDA (calculated); 9M and short-year EBITDA annualised. n.m. when annualised EBITDA is below SAR 10m or negative.

name: FFO margin
definition: FFO ÷ revenue.

name: Loan to value (book)
definition: Borrowings ÷ total assets at period end (book values).

name: Payout
definition: Distributions declared ÷ FFO.

name: Growth (matched sample)
definition: Group growth uses only companies with figures in both periods. n.m. when the base is below SAR 10m, zero or negative, or a profit turns into a loss.

name: Compound annual growth 2022–25
definition: (FY2025 ÷ FY2022)^(1/3) − 1. Group CAGR uses companies with figures in every year 2022–2025; n.m. for a company whose span includes a short year.

name: Organic and like-for-like growth
definition: Organic = reported growth − perimeter (acquisitions/disposals) − FX − hyperinflation − accounting changes; like-for-like = organic − revenue from new capacity. 'Not determinable' where the filings do not allow a step to be measured; 'none identified' where they show there was nothing.

name: Contribution to group growth
definition: A company's change in the metric ÷ the group's prior-period total (matched sample), in percentage points; contributions add up to group growth.

name: Share of group
definition: A company's figure ÷ the group total for the same period.

name: Concentration index (HHI)
definition: Sum of squared revenue shares × 10,000. Above 2,500 is highly concentrated; 10,000 = one company.
